_description: $100k one-time Roth conversion at age 65 with California 5% state tax, MFJ standard deduction. Verifies conversion fully executes and tax is drawn from the Taxable account.
_rationale: Age 65, MFJ. $100k Traditional conversion. No other income. California ~5% state tax (flat approximation in STATE_TAX_RATES). MFJ standard deduction 2026 ≈ $31k + senior extras. $100k ordinary gross - ~$33k deduction ≈ $67k taxable → falls into 10% + 12% brackets. Federal tax ~$7,500; state 5% × $67k ≈ $3,300 → total tax ~$10,000-12,000. Taxable account has $50k to absorb the tax; it should drop by that much. Traditional should drop by exactly 100k (the conversion). Roth should rise by 100k.
name: Roth Conversion — With Tax
